content.evidence_note: Current-role reading covers the dual proof, shielding argument, compiler and consistency argument. Long worked hardness proof is source-linked in the integer Theorem; no independent Reviewer result is claimed.
failure_modes: Approximate transcript agreement is insufficient for an exact-real value oracle.
Unbounded query/output norms break cap control; gradient feedback requires additional consistency checks.
A sentinel protecting only queried points does not protect an arbitrary unqueried output.
This is a proof method with worked interfaces, not an additional established complexity theorem or full Hard Family record.
content.goal_pattern: Keep all past exact value replies invariant while completing hidden directions after adaptive blocks, then prevent the terminal output from reaching the last coordinate.
content.key_choice: Use the support of every exact dual maximizer, rather than activity at a single proximal point. Select each new direction only after its entire adaptive block; include a sentinel orthogonal to the terminal output.
content.key_relation: For any j in [m], if |y_k|<=rho for all k>=j, every dual maximizer is supported on {1,...,j} and h(y)=h(y_1,...,y_j,0,...,0). If y_j=0 this equals h(y_1,...,y_{j-1},0,...,0). Equality is exact.
proof_skeleton: Local shielding argument (Lemma 6.3): c_i=y_i-8 rho i gives c_j-c_k>=6 rho for k>j. If a dual maximizer had p_k>0, move all p_k to j. Objective increase equals p_k(c_j-c_k)-(rho/2)p_j p_k >= p_k(6 rho-rho/2)>0, contradiction. Zeroing the tail also satisfies the same tail bounds and forces support on the same face; objectives coincide on that face, proving exact equality.

Worked calibration: R0=R/4, rho=R/(256 m^(3/2)), A=beta rho/8, eta=beta/(4096m^2), q0(x)=(beta/8)dist(x,B_2^d(R0))^2+(eta/2)||x||^2. Set b=floor(d/4), T=qb+s<bm, 0<=s<b. During complete block j answer A h(<u1,x>,...,<u_(j-1),x>,0,...,0)+q0(x); these replies do not use u_j.

After the complete block is fixed choose unit u_j orthogonal to previous directions and all b current queries, with |<u_j,x_t>|<=rho on all earlier queries. The remaining subspace has dimension >=d/2. Cap avoidance supplies such a vector: for M bounded vectors, p rho^2>=64 R^2 log(4(M+1)) suffices in a p-dimensional subspace. Here M<=d^2/16+1 and m^3 log(ed)<=c0 d validates every selection.

Answer the incomplete block using the q-direction prefix. After all replies fix xhat, choose u_(q+1) orthogonal to previous directions, all incomplete-block queries AND xhat; impose small projections on earlier queries. Complete later directions with small projections on every query AND xhat. This also works when s=0, q=0 or T=0.

Define one final F_U(x)=A h(U^T x)+q0(x), U^T U=I_m. At a block-j query coordinate j is exactly zero and every later coordinate is rho-small. Shielding gives equality with its original reply. Induction on the deterministic policy gives the identical true transcript and terminal output for this fixed F_U.

The sentinel gives i_rho^+(U^T xhat)<=q+1<=m, with i_rho^+(y)=min{i: |y_k|<=rho for every k>=i}, or m+1 if empty. Comparing with ycirc=-(R0/sqrt(m))1_m, xcirc=U ycirc, yields the source-linked integer lower bound; model membership and the gap are separate obligations detailed in the linked Theorem.
content.required_inputs: m>=1, rho>0; g(y)=max_{1<=i<=m}(y_i-8 rho i), h(y)=inf_z[g(z)+||z-y||_2^2/rho]. Its simplex dual is h(y)=max_{p>=0,sum p_i=1}[sum p_i(y_i-8 rho i)-(rho/4)||p||_2^2]. For the worked compiler use X=B_2^d(R), C=B_2^d(R/2). F_beta(d,R) consists of convex C^1 functions f:R^d->R with globally beta-Lipschitz gradient in Euclidean norm and a unique global minimizer x_f^* in C; f^*=min_R^d f. At time t a deterministic Borel map Q_t:(X x R)^(t-1)->X chooses x_t from the exact history (x_i,f(x_i)); a Borel Q_out:(X x R)^T->X returns any feasible point, which need not have been queried. The unknown objective is fixed. Only exact scalar f(x) is returned; arbitrary exact-real internal computation is free. Repeated oracle calls count; reuse of an already stored value makes no new call. Require d sufficiently large, integer 1<=m<=d/4 and m^3 log(ed)<=c0 d.
transfer_obligations: Reprove the exact dual-support identity after changing the bias, envelope parameter or oracle feedback.
Check available orthogonal-complement dimension and simultaneous projection bound for every block, prior query and terminal output.
Establish global smoothness, minimizer promise, uniqueness and a quantitative comparison gap; shielding alone is not hardness.
Reprove a distributional or posterior argument for randomized policies; the transcript-dependent deterministic frame does not supply one.

use_restrictions: The lower bound covers deterministic adaptive Borel policies with bounded queries and output; it is not a randomized, unrestricted-query, C^2/C^infinity or fixed-condition-number lower bound.
The local shielding calculation is explicit; the transfer obligations are not automatic guarantees.

summary: A worked proof method retaining exact scalar-value transcript equality and protection of an arbitrary unqueried feasible output.
title: Exact prefix shielding and batched delayed rotations
use_when: Construct one fixed smooth objective against a bounded deterministic adaptive exact-value policy; approximate equality cannot hide exact real values.
